evidence.observedFact: The business requires 24 hours notice for cancellation or rescheduling; clients who give less notice are responsible for the full appointment amount.
Online booking is available for the Willoughby location, while Beachwood availability requires direct contact.
The business states it moved to its Downtown Willoughby location and publicly promotes current booking from that location.

The practice offers repeatable therapeutic services including 60- and 90-minute massage sessions and post-operative recovery sessions, with some prospective post-op clients requiring a phone or Zoom consultation.

gaps.recommendedFix: Demonstrate confirmations, reminders and rescheduling recovery designed to protect appointment utilization while preserving the existing cancellation policy.
Automate permission-based follow-up for direct-contact availability requests and consultation-dependent services so qualified prospects receive timely next-step prompts.
Use service-appropriate comeback reminders for clients receiving repeatable therapeutic and recovery services, without making medical outcome claims.

notes: Observed facts show a strict late-cancellation policy, mixed online/direct-contact booking paths and recurring therapeutic services. The commercial hypothesis is that automated reminders, follow-up and repeat-visit workflows can improve customer continuity. No monetary loss or medical benefit is claimed.
